dedupe_keys.name: hinweiskarte starkregengefahren german heavy rainfall hazard indication map bkg

description: The Hinweiskarte Starkregengefahren is a nationwide heavy rainfall (pluvial flooding) hazard indication map for Germany. For every square metre it shows the maximum flood depth, the maximum flow velocity and the flow direction for two simulated events: an exceptional event with regional rainfall amounts of about a 100-year return period from the KOSTRA-DWD data, and an extreme event of 100 mm in one hour. The simulations use the 1 metre terrain model DGM1, ATKIS and ALKIS data and information on culverts, pumping stations and buildings. It is produced by the Federal Agency for Cartography and Geodesy (BKG) with the federal states and the LAWA working group; twelve states were complete in early 2026, and nationwide coverage is due from the end of 2026. The data are available free as GeoTIFF downloads and a WMS under the Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0. Caveats: BKG warns the map is not accurate to the metre and is not a basis for local risk assessment or adaptation design. It gives a consistent national pluvial flood exposure layer for roads, rail, utilities and buildings; a related record is the Global Flood Database.
